From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC outcomes + short endorsement ask (15m)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for partnering on the two-week POC. Quick recap of the highlights we pulled together (attached as a brief):

- Inference latency: average 68ms p95 on the production-like workload (vs. your previous setup ~220ms).
- Cost per 1k inferences: ~40% reduction after autoscaling + model quantization.
- Error/noise rate on NLU intents: fell from 6.2% -> 2.8% in our test prompts.

Those improvements align with your internal success criteria from kickoff, so it looks like we hit the outcome targets.

Would you be open to a very short public endorsement — just a 1–2 sentence blurb we can use in a customer spotlight — and a brief 15-minute call to capture it on Wednesday or Thursday? If you prefer, a quick written quote is totally fine.

Attaching the two-page POC summary and the raw charts.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
